ayahs.translation: So fear Allah as much as ye can; listen and obey and spend in charity for the benefit of your own soul and those saved from the covetousness of their own souls,- they are the ones that achieve prosperity.

ayahs.arabic: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: If ye loan to Allah, a beautiful loan, He will double it to your (credit), and He will grant you Forgiveness: for Allah is most Ready to appreciate (service), Most Forbearing,-

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.translation: Knower of what is open, Exalted in Might, Full of Wisdom.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٍۢ مُّبَيِّنَةٍۢ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥ ۚ لَا تَدْرِى لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: O Prophet! When ye do divorce women, divorce them at their prescribed periods, and count (accurately), their prescribed periods: And fear Allah your Lord: and turn them not out of their houses, nor shall they (themselves) leave, except in case they are guilty of some open lewdness, those are limits set by Allah: and any who transgresses the limits of Allah, does verily wrong his (own) soul: thou knowest not if perchance Allah will bring about thereafter some new situation.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًۭا
ayahs.translation: Thus when they fulfil their term appointed, either take them back on equitable terms or part with them on equitable terms; and take for witness two persons from among you, endued with justice, and establish the evidence (as) before Allah. Such is the admonition given to him who believes in Allah and the Last Day. And for those who fear Allah, He (ever) prepares a way out,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: And He provides for him from (sources) he never could imagine. And if any one puts his trust in Allah, sufficient is (Allah) for him. For Allah will surely accomplish his purpose: verily, for all things has Allah appointed a due proportion.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى يَئِسْنَ مِنَ ٱلْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمْ إِنِ ٱرْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرٍۢ وَٱلَّٰٓـِٔى لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰتُ ٱلْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Such of your women as have passed the age of monthly courses, for them the prescribed period, if ye have any doubts, is three months, and for those who have no courses (it is the same): for those who carry (life within their wombs), their period is until they deliver their burdens: and for those who fear Allah, He will make their path easy.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا
ayahs.translation: That is the Command of Allah, which He has sent down to you: and if any one fears Allah, He will remove his ills, from him, and will enlarge his reward.

ayahs.arabic: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُو۟لَٰتِ حَمْلٍۢ فَأَنفِقُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا۟ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍۢ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Let the women live (in 'iddat) in the same style as ye live, according to your means: Annoy them not, so as to restrict them. And if they carry (life in their wombs), then spend (your substance) on them until they deliver their burden: and if they suckle your (offspring), give them their recompense: and take mutual counsel together, according to what is just and reasonable. And if ye find yourselves in difficulties, let another woman suckle (the child) on the (father's) behalf.

ayahs.arabic: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍۢ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍۢ يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Let the man of means spend according to his means: and the man whose resources are restricted, let him spend according to what Allah has given him. Allah puts no burden on any person beyond what He has given him. After a difficulty, Allah will soon grant relief.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: How many populations that insolently opposed the Command of their Lord and of His messengers, did We not then call to account,- to severe account?- and We imposed on them an exemplary Punishment.

ayahs.arabic: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا
ayahs.translation: Then did they taste the evil result of their conduct, and the End of their conduct was Perdition.

ayahs.arabic: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Allah has prepared for them a severe Punishment (in the Hereafter). Therefore fear Allah, O ye men of understanding - who have believed!- for Allah hath indeed sent down to you a Message,-

ayahs.arabic: رَّسُولًۭا يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًۭا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقًا
ayahs.translation: An Messenger, who rehearses to you the Signs of Allah containing clear explanations, that he may lead forth those who believe and do righteous deeds from the depths of Darkness into Light. And those who believe in Allah and work righteousness, He will admit to Gardens beneath which Rivers flow, to dwell therein for ever: Allah has indeed granted for them a most excellent Provision.

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ وَمِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ ٱلْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۢا
ayahs.translation: Allah is He Who created seven Firmaments and of the earth a similar number. Through the midst of them (all) descends His Command: that ye may know that Allah has power over all things, and that Allah comprehends, all things in (His) Knowledge.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.translation: O Prophet! Why holdest thou to be forbidden that which Allah has made lawful to thee? Thou seekest to please thy consorts. But Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.translation: Allah has already ordained for you, (O men), the dissolution of your oaths (in some cases): and Allah is your Protector, and He is Full of Knowledge and Wisdom.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًۭا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
ayahs.translation: When the Prophet disclosed a matter in confidence to one of his consorts, and she then divulged it (to another), and Allah made it known to him, he confirmed part thereof and repudiated a part. Then when he told her thereof, she said, "Who told thee this? "He said, "He told me Who knows and is well-acquainted (with all things)."

ayahs.arabic: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
ayahs.translation: If ye two turn in repentance to Him, your hearts are indeed so inclined; But if ye back up each other against him, truly Allah is his Protector, and Gabriel, and (every) righteous one among those who believe,- and furthermore, the angels - will back (him) up.

ayahs.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجًا خَيْرًۭا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَٰتٍۢ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٍۢ قَٰنِتَٰتٍۢ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتٍۢ سَٰٓئِحَٰتٍۢ ثَيِّبَٰتٍۢ وَأَبْكَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: It may be, if he divorced you (all), that Allah will give him in exchange consorts better than you,- who submit (their wills), who believe, who are devout, who turn to Allah in repentance, who worship (in humility), who travel (for Faith) and fast,- previously married or virgins.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ قُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًۭا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌۭ شِدَادٌۭ لَّا يَعْصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: O ye who believe! save yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is Men and Stones, over which are (appointed) angels stern (and) severe, who flinch not (from executing) the Commands they receive from Allah, but do (precisely) what they are commanded.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: (They will say), "O ye Unbelievers! Make no excuses this Day! Ye are being but requited for all that ye did!"

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوْبَةًۭ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
ayahs.translation: O ye who believe! Turn to Allah with sincere repentance: In the hope that your Lord will remove from you your ills and admit you to Gardens beneath which Rivers flow,- the Day that Allah will not permit to be humiliated the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their Light will run forward before them and by their right hands, while they say, "Our Lord! Perfect our Light for us, and grant us Forgiveness: for Thou hast power over all things."

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.translation: O Prophet! Strive hard against the Unbelievers and the Hypocrites, and be firm against them. Their abode is Hell,- an evil refuge (indeed).

ayahs.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
ayahs.translation: Allah sets forth, for an example to the Unbelievers, the wife of Noah and the wife of Lut: they were (respectively) under two of our righteous servants, but they were false to their (husbands), and they profited nothing before Allah on their account, but were told: "Enter ye the Fire along with (others) that enter!"

ayahs.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: And Allah sets forth, as an example to those who believe the wife of Pharaoh: Behold she said: "O my Lord! Build for me, in nearness to Thee, a mansion in the Garden, and save me from Pharaoh and his doings, and save me from those that do wrong";

ayahs.arabic: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ
ayahs.translation: And Mary the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity; and We breathed into (her body) of Our spirit; and she testified to the truth of the words of her Lord and of His Revelations, and was one of the devout (servants).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.translation: Blessed be He in Whose hands is Dominion; and He over all things hath Power;-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
ayahs.translation: He Who created Death and Life, that He may try which of you is best in deed: and He is the Exalted in Might, Oft-Forgiving;-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
ayahs.translation: He Who created the seven heavens one above another: No want of proportion wilt thou see in the Creation of (Allah) Most Gracious. So turn thy vision again: seest thou any flaw?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Again turn thy vision a second time: (thy) vision will come back to thee dull and discomfited, in a state worn out.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.translation: And we have, (from of old), adorned the lowest heaven with Lamps, and We have made such (Lamps) (as) missiles to drive away the Evil Ones, and have prepared for them the Penalty of the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.translation: For those who reject their Lord (and Cherisher) is the Penalty of Hell: and evil is (such), Destination.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
ayahs.translation: When they are cast therein, they will hear the (terrible) drawing in of its breath even as it blazes forth,

ayahs.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Almost bursting with fury: Every time a Group is cast therein, its Keepers will ask, "Did no Warner come to you?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
ayahs.translation: They will say: "Yes indeed; a Warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said, 'Allah never sent down any (Message): ye are nothing but an egregious delusion!'"

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.translation: They will further say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we should not (now) be among the Companions of the Blazing Fire!"

ayahs.arabic: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.translation: They will then confess their sins: but far will be (Forgiveness) from the Companions of the Blazing Fire!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.translation: As for those who fear their Lord unseen, for them is Forgiveness and a great Reward.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.translation: And whether ye hide your word or publish it, He certainly has (full) knowledge, of the secrets of (all) hearts.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
ayahs.translation: Should He not know,- He that created? and He is the One that understands the finest mysteries (and) is well-acquainted (with them).

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
ayahs.translation: It is He Who has made the earth manageable for you, so traverse ye through its tracts and enjoy of the Sustenance which He furnishes: but unto Him is the Resurrection.

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
ayahs.translation: Do ye feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not cause you to be swallowed up by the earth when it shakes (as in an earthquake)?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
ayahs.translation: Or do ye feel secure that He Who is in Heaven will not send against you a violent tornado (with showers of stones), so that ye shall know how (terrible) was My warning?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.translation: But indeed men before them rejected (My warning): then how (terrible) was My rejection (of them)?

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.translation: Do they not observe the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them in? None can uphold them except (Allah) Most Gracious: Truly (Allah) Most Gracious: Truly it is He that watches over all things.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
ayahs.translation: Nay, who is there that can help you, (even as) an army, besides (Allah) Most Merciful? In nothing but delusion are the Unbelievers.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
ayahs.translation: Or who is there that can provide you with Sustenance if He were to withhold His provision? Nay, they obstinately persist in insolent impiety and flight (from the Truth).

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Is then one who walks headlong, with his face grovelling, better guided,- or one who walks evenly on a Straight Way?

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Say: "It is He Who has created you (and made you grow), and made for you the faculties of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Say: "It is He Who has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered together."

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: They ask: When will this promise be (fulfilled)? - If ye are telling the truth.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Say: "As to the knowledge of the time, it is with Allah alone: I am (sent) only to warn plainly in public."

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.translation: At length, when they see it close at hand, grieved will be the faces of the Unbelievers, and it will be said (to them): "This is (the promise fulfilled), which ye were calling for!"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Say: "See ye?- If Allah were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Say: "He is (Allah) Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which (of us) it is that is in manifest error."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
ayahs.translation: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost (in the underground earth), who then can supply you with clear-flowing water?"

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write,-

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing:

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see,

ayahs.arabic: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
ayahs.translation: Which of you is afflicted with madness.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
ayahs.translation: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth).

ayahs.arabic: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍۢ مَّهِينٍ
ayahs.translation: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths,

ayahs.arabic: هَمَّازٍۢ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,

ayahs.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: (Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin,

ayahs.arabic: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born,-

ayahs.arabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.translation: Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translation: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries!

ayahs.arabic: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
ayahs.translation: Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.translation: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
ayahs.translation: But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will").

ayahs.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
ayahs.translation: So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered).

ayahs.arabic: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.translation: As the morning broke, they called out, one to another,-

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: "Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits."

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ
ayahs.translation: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)-

ayahs.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ
ayahs.translation: "Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day."

ayahs.arabic: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍۢ قَٰدِرِينَ
ayahs.translation: And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.translation: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way:

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
ayahs.translation: "Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)!"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.translation: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)?'"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong!"

ayahs.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Then they turned, one against another, in reproach.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!

ayahs.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.translation: "It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)!"

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin?

ayahs.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.translation: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌۭ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or have ye a book through which ye learn-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
ayahs.translation: That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand?

ayahs.arabic: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that!

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: Or have they some "Partners" (in Allahhead)? Then let them produce their "partners", if they are truthful!

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.translation: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able,-

ayahs.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not.

ayahs.arabic: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
ayahs.translation: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.translation: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down?

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ
ayahs.translation: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.

ayahs.arabic: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.translation: Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translation: But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.translation: The Sure Reality!

ayahs.arabic: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.translation: What is the Sure Reality?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.translation: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
ayahs.translation: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
ayahs.translation: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;

ayahs.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!

ayahs.arabic: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.

ayahs.arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.translation: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.translation: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),

ayahs.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,

ayahs.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ
ayahs.translation: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
ayahs.translation: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
ayahs.translation: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
ayahs.translation: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"

ayahs.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: And he will be in a life of Bliss,

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: In a Garden on high,

ayahs.arabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.translation: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
ayahs.translation: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
ayahs.translation: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!

ayahs.arabic: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
ayahs.translation: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
ayahs.translation: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!

ayahs.arabic: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ
ayahs.translation: "My power has perished from me!"...

ayahs.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
ayahs.translation: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
ayahs.translation: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
ayahs.translation: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translation: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.translation: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!

ayahs.arabic: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌۭ
ayahs.translation: "So no friend hath he here this Day.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ
ayahs.translation: "Which none do eat but those in sin."

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: So I do call to witness what ye see,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: And what ye see not,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translation: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
ayahs.translation: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,

ayahs.arabic: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.translation: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
ayahs.translation: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
ayahs.translation: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.translation: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.translation: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.translation: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translation: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ
ayahs.translation: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-

ayahs.arabic: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌۭ
ayahs.translation: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-

ayahs.arabic: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
ayahs.translation: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.

ayahs.arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًۭا جَمِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًۭا
ayahs.translation: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):

ayahs.arabic: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًۭا
ayahs.translation: But We see it (quite) near.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
ayahs.translation: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
ayahs.translation: And the mountains will be like wool,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًۭا
ayahs.translation: And no friend will ask after a friend,

ayahs.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
ayahs.translation: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,

ayahs.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
ayahs.translation: His wife and his brother,

ayahs.arabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
ayahs.translation: His kindred who sheltered him,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
ayahs.translation: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
ayahs.translation: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-

ayahs.arabic: نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-

ayahs.arabic: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).

ayahs.arabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!

ayahs.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
ayahs.translation: Truly man was created very impatient;-

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا
ayahs.translation: Fretful when evil touches him;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
ayahs.translation: And niggardly when good reaches him;-

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.translation: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.

ayahs.arabic: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
ayahs.translation: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.translation: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍۢ
ayahs.translation: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.translation: And those who guard their chastity,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.translation: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
ayahs.translation: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
ayahs.translation: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
ayahs.translation: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).

ayahs.arabic: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
ayahs.translation: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
ayahs.translation: From the right and from the left, in crowds?

ayahs.arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ayahs.translation: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translation: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahs.translation: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-

ayahs.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.translation: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.translation: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translation: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.translation: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:

ayahs.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "So I have called to them aloud;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;

ayahs.arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;

ayahs.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).

ayahs.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
ayahs.translation: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),

ayahs.arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا
ayahs.translation: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا
ayahs.translation: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."

ayahs.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
ayahs.translation: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
ayahs.translation: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
ayahs.translation: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
ayahs.translation: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
ayahs.translation: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!

ayahs.arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah;

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
ayahs.translation: 'But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire'-

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
ayahs.translation: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.

ayahs.arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: "Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
ayahs.translation: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
ayahs.translation: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
ayahs.translation: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayahs.translation: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
ayahs.translation: "Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,

ayahs.arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
ayahs.translation: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
ayahs.translation: O thou folded in garments!

ayahs.arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-

ayahs.arabic: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Half of it,- or a little less,

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.

ayahs.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).

ayahs.arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.translation: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
ayahs.translation: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),

ayahs.arabic: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
ayahs.translation: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
ayahs.translation: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
ayahs.translation: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.

ayahs.arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
ayahs.translation: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
ayahs.translation: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.translation: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!

ayahs.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
ayahs.translation: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
ayahs.translation: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!

ayahs.arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
ayahs.translation: Arise and deliver thy warning!

ayahs.arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
ayahs.translation: And thy Lord do thou magnify!

ayahs.arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
ayahs.translation: And thy garments keep free from stain!

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
ayahs.translation: And all abomination shun!

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
ayahs.translation: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!

ayahs.arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
ayahs.translation: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
ayahs.translation: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,

ayahs.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
ayahs.translation: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Far from easy for those without Faith.

ayahs.arabic: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا
ayahs.translation: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا
ayahs.translation: To whom I granted resources in abundance,

ayahs.arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا
ayahs.translation: And sons to be by his side!-

ayahs.arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا
ayahs.translation: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
ayahs.translation: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا
ayahs.translation: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!

ayahs.arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
ayahs.translation: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
ayahs.translation: For he thought and he plotted;-

ayahs.arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
ayahs.translation: And woe to him! How he plotted!-

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
ayahs.translation: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
ayahs.translation: Then he looked round;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
ayahs.translation: Then he frowned and he scowled;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
ayahs.translation: Then he turned back and was haughty;

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
ayahs.translation: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.translation: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"

ayahs.arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
ayahs.translation: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?

ayahs.arabic: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
ayahs.translation: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-

ayahs.arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.translation: Darkening and changing the colour of man!

ayahs.arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
ayahs.translation: Over it are Nineteen.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.translation: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
ayahs.translation: Nay, verily: By the Moon,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
ayahs.translation: And by the Night as it retreateth,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
ayahs.translation: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
ayahs.translation: This is but one of the mighty (portents),

ayahs.arabic: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.translation: A warning to mankind,-

ayahs.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.translation: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-

ayahs.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
ayahs.translation: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.translation: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: And (ask) of the Sinners:

ayahs.arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
ayahs.translation: "What led you into Hell Fire?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.translation: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
ayahs.translation: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;

ayahs.arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
ayahs.translation: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;

ayahs.arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
ayahs.translation: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
ayahs.translation: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.translation: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: As if they were affrighted asses,

ayahs.arabic: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
ayahs.translation: Fleeing from a lion!

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
ayahs.translation: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
ayahs.translation: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Nay, this surely is an admonition:

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
ayahs.translation: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
ayahs.translation: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;

ayahs.arabic: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
ayahs.translation: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?

ayahs.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
ayahs.translation: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
ayahs.translation: At length, when the sight is dazed,

ayahs.arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.translation: And the moon is buried in darkness.

ayahs.arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.translation: And the sun and moon are joined together,-

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
ayahs.translation: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
ayahs.translation: By no means! No place of safety!

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
ayahs.translation: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.

ayahs.arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.translation: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Even though he were to put up his excuses.

ayahs.arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
ayahs.translation: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
ayahs.translation: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
ayahs.translation: And leave alone the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
ayahs.translation: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Looking towards their Lord;

ayahs.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,

ayahs.arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
ayahs.translation: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
ayahs.translation: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"

ayahs.arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
ayahs.translation: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
ayahs.translation: And one leg will be joined with another:

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
ayahs.translation: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-

ayahs.arabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!

ayahs.arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
ayahs.translation: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
ayahs.translation: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
ayahs.translation: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
ayahs.translation: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
ayahs.translation: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
ayahs.translation: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-

ayahs.arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
ayahs.translation: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.

ayahs.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
ayahs.translation: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.

ayahs.arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
ayahs.translation: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
ayahs.translation: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.translation: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."

ayahs.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
ayahs.translation: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.translation: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.

ayahs.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.

ayahs.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.

ayahs.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
ayahs.translation: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-

ayahs.arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).

ayahs.arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
ayahs.translation: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-

ayahs.arabic: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: A fountain there, called Salsabil.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
ayahs.translation: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.translation: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
ayahs.translation: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
ayahs.translation: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
ayahs.translation: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
ayahs.translation: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.

ayahs.arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
ayahs.translation: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.translation: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
ayahs.translation: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.

ayahs.arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
ayahs.translation: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
