ayahs.translation: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
ayahs.translation: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: And scatter (things) far and wide;

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
ayahs.translation: Then separate them, one from another,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
ayahs.translation: Then spread abroad a Message,

ayahs.arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
ayahs.translation: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
ayahs.translation: Then when the stars become dim;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
ayahs.translation: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-

ayahs.arabic: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
ayahs.translation: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?

ayahs.arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
ayahs.translation: For the Day of Sorting out.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translation: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.translation: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Thus do We deal with men of sin.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
ayahs.translation: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayahs.translation: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?

ayahs.arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
ayahs.translation: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.

ayahs.arabic: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
ayahs.translation: The living and the dead,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
ayahs.translation: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.translation: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!

ayahs.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
ayahs.translation: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
ayahs.translation: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
ayahs.translation: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
ayahs.translation: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.translation: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translation: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!

ayahs.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
ayahs.translation: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.translation: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).

ayahs.arabic: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.translation: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.translation: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.translation: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Concerning what are they disputing?

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Concerning the Great News,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.translation: About which they cannot agree.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
ayahs.translation: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
ayahs.translation: And the mountains as pegs?

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
ayahs.translation: And (have We not) created you in pairs,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
ayahs.translation: And made your sleep for rest,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
ayahs.translation: And made the night as a covering,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
ayahs.translation: And made the day as a means of subsistence?

ayahs.arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
ayahs.translation: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
ayahs.translation: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
ayahs.translation: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,

ayahs.arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
ayahs.translation: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
ayahs.translation: And gardens of luxurious growth?

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
ayahs.translation: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.translation: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;

ayahs.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
ayahs.translation: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,

ayahs.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
ayahs.translation: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
ayahs.translation: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,

ayahs.arabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
ayahs.translation: For the transgressors a place of destination:

ayahs.arabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
ayahs.translation: They will dwell therein for ages.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.translation: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
ayahs.translation: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
ayahs.translation: A fitting recompense (for them).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
ayahs.translation: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
ayahs.translation: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
ayahs.translation: And all things have We preserved on record.

ayahs.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
ayahs.translation: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
ayahs.translation: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;

ayahs.arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
ayahs.translation: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;

ayahs.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
ayahs.translation: And voluptuous women of equal age;

ayahs.arabic: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
ayahs.translation: And a cup full (to the brim).

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
ayahs.translation: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
ayahs.translation: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
ayahs.translation: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
ayahs.translation: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.translation: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
ayahs.translation: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (metre) dust!"

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
ayahs.translation: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
ayahs.translation: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
ayahs.translation: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
ayahs.translation: Then press forward as in a race,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
ayahs.translation: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,

ayahs.arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
ayahs.translation: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):

ayahs.arabic: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
ayahs.translation: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;

ayahs.arabic: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
ayahs.translation: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
ayahs.translation: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
ayahs.translation: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Has the story of Moses reached thee?

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.translation: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.translation: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-

ayahs.arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.translation: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
ayahs.translation: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).

ayahs.arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:

ayahs.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
ayahs.translation: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);

ayahs.arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-

ayahs.arabic: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
ayahs.translation: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.translation: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,

ayahs.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.translation: And had preferred the life of this world,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
ayahs.translation: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Their abode will be the Garden.

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?

ayahs.arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
ayahs.translation: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
ayahs.translation: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away,

ayahs.arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.translation: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: To him dost thou attend;

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.translation: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And with fear (in his heart),

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Of him wast thou unmindful.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.

ayahs.arabic: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,

ayahs.arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
ayahs.translation: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,

ayahs.arabic: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: (Written) by the hands of scribes-

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Honourable and Pious and Just.

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;

ayahs.arabic: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: From what stuff hath He created him?

ayahs.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
ayahs.translation: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):

ayahs.arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
ayahs.translation: For that We pour forth water in abundance,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
ayahs.translation: And We split the earth in fragments,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
ayahs.translation: And produce therein corn,

ayahs.arabic: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
ayahs.translation: And Grapes and nutritious plants,

ayahs.arabic: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
ayahs.translation: And Olives and Dates,

ayahs.arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
ayahs.translation: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,

ayahs.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
ayahs.translation: And fruits and fodder,-

ayahs.arabic: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
ayahs.translation: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
ayahs.translation: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
ayahs.translation: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,

ayahs.arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
ayahs.translation: And from his mother and his father,

ayahs.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
ayahs.translation: And from his wife and his children.

ayahs.arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
ayahs.translation: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Some faces that Day will be beaming,

ayahs.arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Laughing, rejoicing.

ayahs.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,

ayahs.arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
ayahs.translation: Blackness will cover them:

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
ayahs.translation: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the oceans boil over with a swell;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -

ayahs.arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
ayahs.translation: For what crime she was killed;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the scrolls are laid open;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the world on High is unveiled;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
ayahs.translation: And when the Garden is brought near;-

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
ayahs.translation: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
ayahs.translation: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
ayahs.translation: Go straight, or hide;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
ayahs.translation: And the Night as it dissipates;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
ayahs.translation: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,

ayahs.arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,

ayahs.arabic: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.translation: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.translation: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
ayahs.translation: When whither go ye?

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:

ayahs.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
ayahs.translation: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translation: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the Sky is cleft asunder;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the Stars are scattered;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.translation: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
ayahs.translation: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
ayahs.translation: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.translation: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
ayahs.translation: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;

ayahs.arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.translation: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.translation: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):

ayahs.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: They know (and understand) all that ye do.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,

ayahs.arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
ayahs.translation: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.translation: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
ayahs.translation: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ayahs.translation: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.translation: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-

ayahs.arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: On a Mighty Day,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translation: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?

ayahs.arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
ayahs.translation: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.translation: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translation: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.translation: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
ayahs.translation: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.translation: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.translation: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?

ayahs.arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
ayahs.translation: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,

ayahs.arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.translation: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.translation: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):

ayahs.arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.

ayahs.arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
ayahs.translation: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:

ayahs.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
ayahs.translation: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:

ayahs.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:

ayahs.arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.translation: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.translation: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
ayahs.translation: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.translation: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.translation: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.translation: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.translation: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.translation: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
ayahs.translation: When the sky is rent asunder,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayahs.translation: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
ayahs.translation: And when the earth is flattened out,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
ayahs.translation: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayahs.translation: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayahs.translation: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
ayahs.translation: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
ayahs.translation: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
ayahs.translation: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
ayahs.translation: Soon will he cry for perdition,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.translation: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
ayahs.translation: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
ayahs.translation: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!

ayahs.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
ayahs.translation: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
ayahs.translation: The Night and its Homing;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
ayahs.translation: And the Moon in her fullness:

ayahs.arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.translation: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
ayahs.translation: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.translation: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
ayahs.translation: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)

ayahs.arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
ayahs.translation: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
ayahs.translation: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
ayahs.translation: By the promised Day (of Judgment);

ayahs.arabic: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
ayahs.translation: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
ayahs.translation: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),

ayahs.arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
ayahs.translation: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel:

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),

ayahs.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ayahs.translation: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.translation: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.translation: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
ayahs.translation: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
ayahs.translation: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,

ayahs.arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
ayahs.translation: Lord of the Throne of Glory,

ayahs.arabic: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
ayahs.translation: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
ayahs.translation: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-

ayahs.arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
ayahs.translation: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud?

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
ayahs.translation: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
ayahs.translation: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,

ayahs.arabic: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
ayahs.translation: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
ayahs.translation: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
ayahs.translation: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
ayahs.translation: There is no soul but has a protector over it.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
ayahs.translation: Now let man but think from what he is created!

ayahs.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
ayahs.translation: He is created from a drop emitted-

ayahs.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
ayahs.translation: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
ayahs.translation: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
ayahs.translation: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
ayahs.translation: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
ayahs.translation: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
ayahs.translation: It is not a thing for amusement.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
ayahs.translation: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
ayahs.translation: And I am planning a scheme.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
ayahs.translation: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
ayahs.translation: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.

ayahs.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).

ayahs.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.translation: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):

ayahs.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayahs.translation: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Who will enter the Great Fire,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayahs.translation: In which they will then neither die nor live.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: But those will prosper who purify themselves,

ayahs.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.translation: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-

ayahs.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.translation: The Books of Abraham and Moses.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
ayahs.translation: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
ayahs.translation: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,

ayahs.arabic: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Labouring (hard), weary,-

ayahs.arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
ayahs.translation: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-

ayahs.arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,

ayahs.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
ayahs.translation: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,

ayahs.arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Pleased with their striving,-

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: In a Garden on high,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
ayahs.translation: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Therein will be a bubbling spring:

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Goblets placed (ready),

ayahs.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And cushions set in rows,

ayahs.arabic: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
ayahs.translation: And rich carpets (all) spread out.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
ayahs.translation: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
ayahs.translation: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
ayahs.translation: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
ayahs.translation: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.

ayahs.arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
ayahs.translation: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
ayahs.translation: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-

ayahs.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
ayahs.translation: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: For to Us will be their return;

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
ayahs.translation: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْفَجْرِ
ayahs.translation: By the break of Day

ayahs.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
ayahs.translation: By the Nights twice five;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
ayahs.translation: By the even and odd (contrasted);

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
ayahs.translation: And by the Night when it passeth away;-

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.translation: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-

ayahs.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
ayahs.translation: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.translation: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?

ayahs.arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
ayahs.translation: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-

ayahs.arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
ayahs.translation: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.translation: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
ayahs.translation: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).

ayahs.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
ayahs.translation: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
ayahs.translation: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
ayahs.translation: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
ayahs.translation: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
ayahs.translation: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.translation: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-

ayahs.arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
ayahs.translation: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,

ayahs.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
ayahs.translation: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
ayahs.translation: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
ayahs.translation: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,

ayahs.arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
ayahs.translation: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.translation: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
ayahs.translation: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!

ayahs.arabic: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
ayahs.translation: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!

ayahs.arabic: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
ayahs.translation: "Enter thou, then, among My devotees!

ayahs.arabic: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
ayahs.translation: "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
ayahs.translation: I do call to witness this City;-

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
ayahs.translation: And thou art a freeman of this City;-

ayahs.arabic: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
ayahs.translation: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
ayahs.translation: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
ayahs.translation: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.translation: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
ayahs.translation: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-

ayahs.arabic: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
ayahs.translation: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-

ayahs.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
ayahs.translation: And shown him the two highways?

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
ayahs.translation: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-

ayahs.arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
ayahs.translation: (It is:) freeing the bondman;

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Or the giving of food in a day of privation

ayahs.arabic: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
ayahs.translation: To the orphan with claims of relationship,

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
ayahs.translation: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
ayahs.translation: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.translation: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
ayahs.translation: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: By the Moon as she follows him;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: By the Night as it conceals it;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:

ayahs.arabic: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: And he fails that corrupts it!

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
ayahs.translation: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,

ayahs.arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
ayahs.translation: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.translation: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
ayahs.translation: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
ayahs.translation: By the Night as it conceals (the light);

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: By the Day as it appears in glory;

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
ayahs.translation: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),

ayahs.arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-

ayahs.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.translation: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And gives the lie to the best,-

ayahs.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayahs.translation: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.

ayahs.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
ayahs.translation: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.translation: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.translation: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
ayahs.translation: By the Glorious Morning Light,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And by the Night when it is still,-

ayahs.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?

ayahs.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.

ayahs.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.translation: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
ayahs.translation: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
ayahs.translation: Nor repulse the petitioner (unheard);

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
ayahs.translation: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
ayahs.translation: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-

ayahs.arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
ayahs.translation: And removed from thee thy burden

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
ayahs.translation: The which did gall thy back?-

ayahs.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
ayahs.translation: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayahs.translation: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.translation: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
ayahs.translation: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
ayahs.translation: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.

ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
ayahs.translation: By the Fig and the Olive,

ayahs.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
ayahs.translation: And the Mount of Sinai,

ayahs.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
ayahs.translation: And this City of security,-

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
ayahs.translation: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.translation: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
ayahs.translation: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
ayahs.translation: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:

ayahs.arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
ayahs.translation: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
ayahs.translation: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-

ayahs.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
ayahs.translation: Taught man that which he knew not.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,

ayahs.arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Seest thou one who forbids-

ayahs.arabic: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: A votary when he (turns) to pray?

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Or enjoins Righteousness?

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.translation: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
ayahs.translation: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayahs.translation: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-

ayahs.arabic: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: A lying, sinful forelock!

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):

ayahs.arabic: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
ayahs.translation: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
ayahs.translation: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!

ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayahs.translation: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?

ayahs.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
ayahs.translation: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
ayahs.translation: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.translation: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence,-

ayahs.arabic: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
ayahs.translation: An messenger from Allah, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy:

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.translation: Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
ayahs.translation: And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship Allah, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.translation: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.translation: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures.

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Their reward is with Allah: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; Allah well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
ayahs.translation: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
ayahs.translation: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
ayahs.translation: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
ayahs.translation: On that Day will she declare her tidings:

ayahs.arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
ayahs.translation: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
ayahs.translation: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
ayahs.translation: And strike sparks of fire,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
ayahs.translation: And push home the charge in the morning,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
ayahs.translation: And raise the dust in clouds the while,

ayahs.arabic: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
ayahs.translation: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
ayahs.translation: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: And violent is he in his love of wealth.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
ayahs.translation: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad

ayahs.arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.translation: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
ayahs.translation: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.translation: The (Day) of Noise and Clamour:

ayahs.arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.translation: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
ayahs.translation: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
ayahs.translation: And the mountains will be like carded wool.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,

ayahs.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayahs.translation: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-

ayahs.arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee what this is?

ayahs.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
ayahs.translation: (It is) a Fire Blazing fiercely!

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
ayahs.translation: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
ayahs.translation: Until ye visit the graves.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Again, ye soon shall know!

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.translation: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)

ayahs.arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
ayahs.translation: Ye shall certainly see Hell-Fire!

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.translation: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.translation: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَصْرِ
ayahs.translation: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages),

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Verily Man is in loss,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
ayahs.translation: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
ayahs.translation: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,

ayahs.arabic: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
ayahs.translation: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
ayahs.translation: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
ayahs.translation: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?

ayahs.arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
ayahs.translation: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
ayahs.translation: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
ayahs.translation: It shall be made into a vault over them,

ayahs.arabic: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
ayahs.translation: In columns outstretched.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
ayahs.translation: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?

ayahs.arabic: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
ayahs.translation: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,

ayahs.arabic: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Striking them with stones of baked clay.

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
ayahs.translation: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
ayahs.translation: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,

ayahs.arabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
ayahs.translation: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
ayahs.translation: Let them adore the Lord of this House,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
ayahs.translation: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?

ayahs.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
ayahs.translation: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.translation: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.

ayahs.arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.translation: So woe to the worshippers

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.translation: Who are neglectful of their prayers,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
ayahs.translation: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),

ayahs.arabic: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
ayahs.translation: But refuse (to supply) (even) neighbourly needs.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
ayahs.translation: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).

ayahs.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
ayahs.translation: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
ayahs.translation: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: Say: O ye that reject Faith!

ayahs.arabic: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.translation: I worship not that which ye worship,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
ayahs.translation: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
ayahs.translation: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
ayahs.translation: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.

ayahs.arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
ayahs.translation: To you be your Way, and to me mine.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
ayahs.translation: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,

ayahs.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.translation: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
ayahs.translation: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
ayahs.translation: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.translation: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!

ayahs.arabic: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ
ayahs.translation: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!

ayahs.arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
ayahs.translation: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-

ayahs.arabic: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
ayahs.translation: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One and Only;

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
ayahs.translation: Allah, the Eternal, Absolute;

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
ayahs.translation: He begetteth not, nor is He begotten;

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
ayahs.translation: And there is none like unto Him.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
ayahs.translation: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn

ayahs.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
ayahs.translation: From the mischief of created things;

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
ayahs.translation: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads;

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
ayahs.translation: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts;

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
ayahs.translation: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.translation: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind,

ayahs.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.translation: The King (or Ruler) of Mankind,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.translation: The god (or judge) of Mankind,-

ayahs.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
ayahs.translation: From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper),-

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.translation: (The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind,-

ayahs.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.translation: Among Jinns and among men.
